description.value: Rhino Coffee House is an award-winning multi-location coffee shop serving specialty espresso drinks, craft cocktails and beers, and a full all-day food menu including breakfast wraps, sandwiches, bowls, and housemade donuts. The Langford location is the flagship, handling all catering orders for the group and offering both pickup and delivery. It has been recognized as the best coffee shop in the Victoria area.
